method: Whole942line Model.cpp manually read; pinned bytes verified. Actions.cpp1040..1110 excerpt only, not whole-file credit.
findings: ClearScanState orders StopScanningEngine(Abort), watcher stop, top pending clear, icon async queue clear, extension data clear, all visual control clear, then delete old root and null root/zoom. This resolves the earlier open source-level question whether top pending clear is called before old tree destruction on ordinary reset.

Actions refresh excerpt removes duplicate/top/search wrappers before RemoveAllChildren of previously completed nodes. Hardlink derived snapshots removed for affected drives first; selection/expanded state recorded for later restoration. Remaining Actions.cpp requires full review.

IsScanSettled requires root done and coordinator thread not running according to GetExitCodeThread. This is stronger than test-harness title heuristic but API failure yields false running; no Windows API fault-injection or platform conclusion.

StartScan normalizes roots before clearing current model and records pipe-separated scan spec. Builds storage-specific single/multi roots; MTP paths registered separately. Normalization helper definition not whole-file reviewed here.

OpenLoadedScan clears old model, installs saved root, queues existing recursive items for largest-file view, notifies panes and starts empty scan-engine request. This is not itself a new filesystem enumeration; complete empty-request engine behavior remains in Actions.cpp.

Extension registration is snapshotted from HKCR and reused while nonempty; registered/unregistered grouping affects colors, not duplicate-content identity. Byte totals and selected pointers use cached model data.

Physical deletion, shell operations and user-defined commands were read only, never executed. Direct delete path retries remaining top-level items through shell and refreshes model afterward; return values alone do not establish successful deletion.

User-defined cleanup is a configurable COMSPEC command; placeholder substitution is not general shell quoting. Its behavior belongs to explicit user-authored actions, not core duplicate comparison. No command generation or execution test performed.
limits: No Windows coordinator, UI, deletion, shell, command or filesystem execution.
No concurrency guarantee inferred from source call order alone.
No production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred.
